title: Wet Wrap Therapy for Eczema: A Demonstration by Dr Kartini
description: Consultant Dermatologist Dr Kartini Farah Rahim demonstrates wet wrap therapy, a technique dermatologists use alongside prescribed treatment to soothe, hydrate and protect skin during an eczema flare.

title: Eczema Wet Wrap Therapy for the Legs (Bahasa Malaysia)
description: A Bahasa Malaysia demonstration of how to apply wet wraps to the legs for eczema, featuring Consultant Dermatologist Dr Kartini Farah Rahim.

title: Dr Kartini's Tips for Treating Atopic Eczema, Part 1 (Bahasa Malaysia)
description: In this Bahasa Malaysia video, Dr Kartini Farah Rahim shares practical tips on managing atopic eczema (ekzema atopik) as part of a dermatologist-guided treatment plan.

title: Eczema and Children, Part 2 (Ekzema & Kanak-kanak)
description: A Bahasa Malaysia discussion with Dr Kartini Farah Rahim about eczema in children, for parents and caregivers looking after a child's sensitive, itchy skin.

title: Atopic Dermatitis with Dr Kartini Rahim on Sky TV (Bahasa Malaysia)
description: A televised Bahasa Malaysia interview in which Consultant Dermatologist Dr Kartini Farah Rahim discusses atopic dermatitis (dermatitis atopik), commonly known as eczema.

title: Oli the Rabbit: Eczema Stories for Children
description: Dr Kartini Farah Rahim reads from the Oli the Rabbit eczema story collection, a gentle way to help young children understand living with eczema.

title: Learning with Dr Kartini: Skin Moisture, Part 1 (Kelembapan Kulit)
description: Part one of a Bahasa Malaysia education series in which Dr Kartini Farah Rahim explains skin moisture, the skin barrier and why the right moisturiser matters.

title: Learning with Dr Kartini: Skin Moisture, Episode 2 (Kelembapan Kulit)
description: Episode two of Dr Kartini Farah Rahim's Bahasa Malaysia series on skin moisture, covering how moisturisers work and how to choose one for sensitive skin.

title: Ask Me Doctor with Dr Kartini Rahim: Caring for Children's Skin
description: Consultant Dermatologist Dr Kartini Farah Rahim answers questions about caring for babies' and children's delicate skin on the Ask Me Doctor programme.

title: Ask Dr Kartini: A Dermatologist Answers Your Skin Questions
description: Dr Kartini Farah Rahim answers common skin health questions from her clinic, in the first instalment of the Ask Dr Kartini series.

title: Helo Doktor (2024): Dry Scalp, Scaling and Dandruff with Dr Kartini (TV3)
description: Dr Kartini Farah Rahim appears on TV3's Helo Doktor (14 July 2024) to discuss scalp problems such as dryness, scaling and dandruff (kering, kuping dan kelemumur) in adults and children.

title: Helo Doktor (2021): Scalp and Hair Health with Dr Kartini Farah Rahim
description: A Bahasa Malaysia television episode in which Consultant Dermatologist Dr Kartini Farah Rahim discusses scalp and hair health (kesihatan kulit kepala dan rambut).

title: Bicara DR on RTM: Facial Skin Health with Dr Kartini Farah Rahim
description: Dr Kartini Farah Rahim, Consultant Dermatologist, discusses facial skin health (kesihatan wajah) on RTM's Bicara DR programme, first broadcast on 3 September 2020.

title: Skin Talk with Dr Kartini, Episode 1: Has Your Skin Changed After Ramadan?
description: Dr Kartini Farah Rahim explains why lifestyle changes during and after Ramadan can affect the skin, and answers common skin health questions.

title: TV3: Dr Kartini on Stray Animals and Compassion on the Streets
description: Animal welfare advocate and dermatologist Dr Kartini Farah Rahim features in a TV3 news segment on stray animals and the community members who care for them (August 2025).

title: Episode 1: Understanding Dog Body Language with Dr Kartini and Dr Ima
description: In the first episode of a Bahasa Malaysia series, Dr Kartini Farah Rahim and Dr Ima explain how to read a dog's body language to stay safe around dogs.

title: Episode 2: How to Approach a Dog Safely (Cara Menghampiri Anjing)
description: Dr Kartini Farah Rahim and Dr Ima explain, in Bahasa Malaysia, how to approach a dog calmly and safely.

title: Episode 3: How to Reduce the Risk of Dog Bites (Cara Mengurangkan Risiko Digigit Anjing)
description: Practical Bahasa Malaysia guidance from Dr Kartini Farah Rahim and Dr Ima on reducing the risk of dog bites for adults and children.

title: Episode 4: How to Calm an Aggressive Stray Dog (Cara Menenangkan Anjing Jalanan yang Garang)
description: Dr Kartini Farah Rahim and Dr Ima discuss, in Bahasa Malaysia, how to respond calmly when a stray dog appears aggressive.
